bio.text: Jeana Ross, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 27 since May 1, 2024, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

She earned a bachelor's degree in early childhood education from the University of Alabama at Birmingham in 1975 and a master's degree in educational leadership and administration from the University of Alabama in 2000.

Her career experience includes serving as Secretary of the Alabama Department of Early Childhood Education, as Director of Policy and Children's Affairs with the Alabama Extended Learning Alliance, and as an education consultant.
